newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. peace envoy Ross arrives in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: U.S. peace envoy Ross arrives in Cairo.

text.p: The U.S. special coordinator for Middle East peace talks Dennis Ross arrived in Cairo on Tuesday on a mission to revive the talks, officials said.

Ross will have dinner with Foreign Minister Amr Moussa in Cairo on Tuesday and meet President Hosni Mubarak at his summer holiday home near the Mediterranean city of Alexandria on Wednesday, they added.
He is expected to encourage Egypt to press on with preparations for a Middle East economic summit in Cairo in November, the next fixed event in the peace process calendar.

Mubarak said on Monday that Egypt wanted the summit to go ahead but Israel and the United States had to contribute to ensuring it is a success. He has linked it with Israel meeting some of the Palestinian Authority's demands.

The affair has seriously damaged relations between Egypt and Israel, especially after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Sunday that Egypt was behaving like "a man who cuts off his nose to spite his face".
Ross will travel on to Gaza in the autonomous Palestinian territories and then to Israel. U.S. officials said they did not think he would go to Syria.
